subject.title: fix(compaction): retain CJK sessions within token budget

question: Should `@openclaw/normalization-core/cjk-chars` become a supported public package subpath for standalone agent-core and future consumers?
rationale: The functional repair is narrow and proven, but adding a separately importable normalization-core path creates a durable package API that cannot be safely inferred from implementation correctness alone.

options.title: Approve the stable subpath
options.body: Accept `cjk-chars` as a supported normalization-core API and merge with its emitted root and package artifacts.

options.title: Use an existing approved surface
options.body: Ask for a refactor that keeps the CJK helper available to agent-core without introducing a new independently supported package subpath.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Defer this PR until maintainers decide the intended ownership and public API policy for shared token-estimation helpers.

recommendation.title: Approve the stable subpath
recommendation.body: Accept `cjk-chars` as a supported normalization-core API and merge with its emitted root and package artifacts.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged compaction work is the closest current-main ownership signal for the estimator boundary this PR changes.
